YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy information

This catalogue preview lets you browse products and prepare an enquiry. It does not provide account registration, checkout or payment processing.

Enquiry details

The enquiry builder processes the information you enter in your browser. It does not submit the form to an ARVIGA database. Downloading a brief saves a text file on your device. If an email or WhatsApp option is enabled, the details are passed to that application and are sent only when you choose to send them there.

Local settings and analytics

This version does not install advertising or analytics trackers and does not save enquiry fields in browser storage. Hosting providers may process technical request information. The site's fonts may be supplied by Google Fonts, which receives the requests needed to serve them.

Before public launch

A final privacy policy and business contact details will be published when the site's enquiry channels and operating details are confirmed.
